name: pr-pane
description: Your open pull requests in a Dracula-themed pane: CI, Codex review and whether each one already reached your integration branch, plus a chip above the prompt that flags failing CI.

integrationBranch.title: Integration branch
integrationBranch.description: Branch the pane checks each PR against (staging, homolog, develop). Empty hides the column.

codexBotLogin.title: Codex bot login
codexBotLogin.description: GitHub login of the Codex review bot.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the PR list reloads.

ghPath.title: gh path
ghPath.description: Full path to the GitHub CLI when it is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.
